title: Matt T NDE 6689
content: Prior to the experience I was trying to climb to a new height in the 'climbing tree' in our back yard. I was alone and had no one to help me. I had ascended as far as I could go upward and was attempting to descend, but I could not reach the branch below with my foot. I tried to reach the lower branch, but lost my grip and fell backward, landing flat on my back. I felt as though the air had been knocked out of me to the point I passed out. The pain ceased. I immediately found myself in a dark cave or mine-like tunnel with darkness all around except directly before me. I could see fires before me clearly. Figures were silhouetted in the light. I stared at them for a few moments and did not recognize any of them. Collectively, they appeared old and had 'a bad sort of energy.' A young short lady in black and white stepped forward from the group. She wore a pleasant smile and had a sense of loving kindness about her. I stood about ten feet or so away from her. She said, ‘go back, you don't have to come up here!’ The figures were all human looking. They were in black and white and were located up a ramp at the end of the tunnel. They were backed by a white light that was not harsh to look at. As I turned to walk away, I noticed a hand on my left shoulder. I could see a male hand with a cuffed sleeve like from a garment of thick wool-like material hanging loosely from the wrist. Like perhaps Jesus would have worn. The hand guided me and turned me abruptly into the rock-like wall of the tunnel to my left. I did not see the rest of the person holding my shoulder, but I did notice the area from where I came was dark. The hand on my shoulder guided me directly through the wall and immediately I appeared inside a brightly lit area. The hand was still on my left shoulder. It appeared the area was mainly about seven to eight feet in radius but had no wall. The boundaries were more like whiffs of clouds of white and pearl color mixed like fluffed cotton candy. In the center on the floor was a half-buried orb of golden glowing energy. I got a glimpse of it. It was more yellow in the center and golden around the outer edge. Then I was not able to look directly at it anymore. I suddenly notice about five or six translucent male figures standing about the orb of which 'rays of a whitish light were being emitted. All the men were standing at different distances from the orb. All were facing inward with the exception of one who was standing with his back to the orb. All were adult images. At least two had beards. One wore a shortly cropped beard with medium length hair and appeared to be late twenties to mid-thirty in age. Another appeared to be seventy or so and sported longer, fuller hair with a matching beard. These men did not move. They strode motionless. I could see the orb if I looked through the younger man without hurting me eyes. They were all translucent. The feeling of love (that kind of love one feels when held by a loving mother as an infant) was far more intense there than any I have ever felt before or sense. A voice spoke out and asked, ‘are you worthy of this level of existence?’ Immediately I felt within myself the 'feeling of doubt'. And, just like that, I was gone from that area. Poof! Gone! Suddenly, I was in a much larger area apparently outside of the orb containing area. I could see rays leaving the 'ceiling' of the area heading toward pearly, billowy 'clouds' directly above. It was beautiful. I could not see the men inside. The hand was still on my shoulder. Again, I was asked by a voice from 'everywhere'. ‘Are you worthy of this level of existence?’ And, as before, I felt the feeling of doubt and I was gone from that 'place'. I immediately 'reappeared' in a much larger space. The sky was black in contrast to rolling hills of blue glasslike turf and a 'golden road' running between the hills of blue glass. I was no longer accompanied by the hand on my shoulder and I walked toward the 'golden road'. I recall sitting along the road and picking up Kerala from the road. They appeared like gold-covered raisins but were lighter than popcorn and made up a perfectly grouped road about twelve to fifteen feet wide. The road traveled from my left to my right and went from horizon to horizon. There was nothing else in this picture. I walked from this road back up the hill I had just descended. I instantly knew I was not worthy here either, as I walked over the hill and viewed the horizon from the highest point. The road had disappeared. I could only see blue glass in the form of a descending slope to a mile long beach from my right to my left. The beach was longer to my right. There was a storm-like event with dark gray clouds to my upper right. Beyond the beach directly before me was pure darkness. A pure and endless void. I walked down the slope toward the beach with the 'storm' billowing to the right. I noticed the feeling of love here, but it was much, much less than from the area containing the orb. It was still much greater than I had ever experienced at home, in my regular life. As I approached the beach, I could see 'beings.' Infant-sized beings walking along the beach mixing together. Some were standing still, while some were scurrying about. There were some alone and some in groups. There were millions. They could 'walk through' each other. There were no 'adult'-appearing beings in sight, only the infant-sized and appearing ones. Suddenly a voice from the 'storm cloud' bellowed out a question: ‘Who wants to be born of alcoholic parents?’ This was one example. I don't recall all of the questions being asked, but there were several. However, each time a question was asked a 'being' responded by flying off into the dark abyss before me. I felt fear and ran to my left, further with each question. That was asked not wanting to respond. ‘No, not me,’ I said to myself. I ran to the end of the beach screaming, ‘no, no, no!’ I had never felt so much 'love' before and did not want to ever lose it. Then, I was at the end of the beach to my far left. I could go no further. I was at a point at the end with nowhere else to go. I was, however, happy to be there. I could feel the 'love' and that's all that mattered. I was content right there! Then, just as suddenly as before, I heard ‘my’ question. I don’t recall what it was, but I felt compelled to accept. I 'flew' off into the darkness before me in a giant swooping action. There was 'nothingness', just my thoughts and me. I did not want to think. I floated there in the darkness for what seemed like a long, long time. I felt nothing, saw nothing, heard nothing. I even stopped thinking. I was, but I wasn't. Then I heard bubbling sounds first, and then I could see red. I could taste nothing and do not recall feeling anything physically. The ever-so-faint feeling of 'love' lingered, but a billion times less than on the beach. It was a billion times less than near the orb. This lasted for a while. Then 'one day' I felt compressed and claustrophobic and to make this brief, I went through a birth process. I felt cold and lights bothered my eyes. I wanted to keep them closed. Then, I woke up, got up from the backyard lawn and walked into the house through the side door. No one else was home. No one witnessed this event but me.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A male hand with a cuffed sleeve "like perhaps Jesus would have worn" guided him, but he did not see the person.
arrival.other_being_detail: A young short lady in black and white with a pleasant smile; five or six translucent male figures around a glowing orb; later millions of infant-sized beings on a beach.

environment.environment_other_detail: Glowing orb of golden energy; pearly cloud-like boundary; black sky; rolling hills of blue glasslike turf; golden road; mile-long beach; storm-like dark gray clouds; endless void/abyss.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He was told 'go back, you don't have to come up here!' and later felt compelled to accept a question about being born; he then experienced 'nothingness' followed by a birth process and waking in the yard.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Transition into darkness/void, then bubbling/red sensations, compression/claustrophobia, then a birth process; then he woke up in the backyard.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell from a tree, landed flat on back, felt air knocked out and passed out.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Pre-birth/birth-process sequence: questions to 'beings' about being born (e.g., 'born of alcoholic parents'), then flying into abyss, then a birth process, then waking in the yard.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with beings and a warning to go back; guided through a wall into orb/light area with worthiness questions; successive transitions to other realms (golden road; beach with infant-sized beings and 'birth' questions); then void and an explicit birth process before waking.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: The 'Are you worthy of this level of existence?' question occurred twice with immediate relocation after doubt.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Explicit 'pre-birth selection' scene with millions of infant-sized beings; voiced questions (e.g., 'Who wants to be born of alcoholic parents?') followed by beings flying into the abyss; experiencer later undergoes a birth process and then wakes back in the original life.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “go back, you don't have to come up here!”; “are you worthy of this level of existence?”; “Who wants to be born of alcoholic parents?”; “no, no, no!”
